positioning: For people who plan on their tablet in the evening or simply prefer dark screens, and who live by a calendar of work and home commitments: a dated 2027 dark mode digital planner that starts Monday, October 26, 2026, splits every day into Work, Home and hourly time blocks, and is easy on the eyes at night with high-contrast light text on deep navy. No top seller offers a dark mode paper planner, and it answers the same top complaints (download, setup, device, getting lost) with a Start here page, a Setup check page and one plain PDF.

must_haves.what: Dated 2027, Monday-start, every date linked: year page to each day, month to its weeks, week to each day, day to the next and previous day.
Covers late 2026 and all of 2027: a head start from Monday, October 26, 2026 with month, week and day pages, so a buyer in October, November or December can start this week.
One landscape PDF that works in Goodnotes (named first), Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes and Xodo on iPad and Android tablets.
The core set buyers use daily: year at a glance, 2027 goals, 12 month pages, a habit tracker every month, every week, every day, and notes pages.
A finished, designed dark look with real typography: two families only (Libre Baskerville for headings and italic labels, Outfit for body), consistent spacing, month tabs from periwinkle to amber.
Instructions printed inside the file (Start here, Setup check, how-the-links-work note), including how to pick a light pen color for dark pages.

fixes.how: Ships as one PDF, not a zip and not split into separate files, under 19.5 MB. Listing copy and photo 9 (How it works) give the download in three steps: buy, download from Etsy in a web browser (the Etsy app cannot download digital files), open the PDF in Goodnotes with Share, then Open in Goodnotes. Start here repeats the steps.

The cover's Open planner button lands on a 4-step Start here page (open it, check the links, choose a light pen, start today) with a jump grid of the head start months and all of 2027 underneath, then a Setup check page with buttons that jump and a pen test box on the dark page. Nothing to assemble: no stickers, covers or add-on files.

Pages are 1024 x 768 landscape, the iPad's own 4:3 shape, so there are no blank bands in Goodnotes; all tabs and dates are plain PDF links. The listing has a Works with / Not for box: Goodnotes, Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes and Xodo on iPad and Android tablets; not made for phones, e-ink tablets (dark pages waste e-ink) or viewing in Files, Photos or a Google Drive preview.

Every day page has the same six boxes in the same places (Top 3, Work, Home on the left; Time blocks 6am to 10pm and Tomorrow on the right) and every week page has the same layout, so there is one page to learn. Home, Year, Goals and Notes are on the top bar of every page.

Month tabs run down the right edge of every page, every date on the year page opens its day, each month page lists its weeks, each week links its seven days, day pages have large previous and next buttons plus a Month / Week trail. Weeks follow ISO 8601 numbering (Week 1 starts Monday, January 4, 2027), so they match work calendars, and a week that spans two months is built once, under the month holding its Thursday; the week of December 28 to January 3 is the last head start week.

Every listing photo is a screenshot of the built file, captioned with the page name. The description lists each page type with counts and says plainly: dark pages only (no light version), landscape only, Monday-start weeks, dated October 26, 2026 to December 31, 2027, no stickers, handwrite or use the app's text tool, English only.

The Setup check page turns 'it doesn't work' into a 30-second test: three buttons that must jump, a pen test box and a four-line Nothing happened? list. The build checks every link resolves and every page is reachable from the cover.

Most support messages are setup questions, so the answers are in the file and the listing: the Setup check fix list, the Start here steps (including the light pen) and a listing FAQ with the top five problems (Etsy app download, which app, links not tapping, how to type in a light color, dark pages only). The listing says what the buyer can do (Setup check, then send the shop an Etsy message) and promises no reply time.

Built for one way of planning and says so: days split into Work and Home with hourly time blocks, weeks with a focus list. The listing shows a real day and week page at readable size and lists what is not inside (no budget, meal or fitness sections, no light version) so buyers who need those do not buy it.

Fourteen months of dated pages (October 26, 2026 to December 31, 2027) with a page for every day. Writing room is generous: half of each day page is time blocks and open lines, each weekday has its own lined box on the week page, text set at 1.1 scale. Photo 2 shows the day page close up at about one and a half times its on-screen size.

unique.name: Dark mode pages
unique.what: Every page is deep navy (#1B1F2B) with soft light text (#EEEAF4, contrast above 14 to 1) and amber accents, designed dark from the start rather than inverted, so it is comfortable for evening planning and on dark-mode iPads. Start here tells buyers to choose a white or pale pen color.
unique.why: No top seller shows a dark mode planner (dark mode look share 0%), and readability complaints mention pale, low-contrast text.

unique.name: Work and Home on every day
unique.what: Each day page has Top 3, a Work list and a Home list on the left and hourly time blocks from 6am to 10pm with a Tomorrow box on the right; each week page has This week's focus, Wins and Next week.
unique.why: No top seller title shows time blocking or a work focus; buyers praise planners that fit how they plan and complain when they do not.

unique.name: Setup check page
unique.what: Buttons that jump to a month, the year and Contents, a pen test box on the dark page, and a fix list for when nothing happens.
unique.why: Download, setup and 'doesn't work' are three of the four biggest complaint clusters; no top seller shows a test page.

look.direction: Designed dark: deep navy paper, soft light ink, amber accents like a desk lamp, landscape. Headings in Libre Baskerville, labels in its italic, body in Outfit: two families, hierarchy from weight, size and italic, no tracked all-caps labels. Month tabs run from pale periwinkle to pale amber with dark tab text. Text, labels, month tabs and month tiles are all at 7 to 1 or more against what sits behind them. One deliberate exception: dates from the month before or after, shown to fill a calendar grid, are dimmed (about 3.7 to 1) so the current month stands out.
avoid: White or cream pages (every top seller)
Pastel rainbow tabs and sticker covers
Sage and teal (our Just Today planner)
Ivory and indigo portrait pages (our Any Monday planner)

price.why: Above what buyers actually pay weighted by sales ($25.66) and inside the best-earning band, for fourteen months of dated pages. While the shop has few reviews it launches with a 30-day 25% Etsy sale on the full price instead of a low price (style rule r015).

spec.index_tip: Tap a card, a month, or a month tab on the right edge. Home on the top bar brings you back here, and calendar pages show a Month / Week trail at the top right. Follow links with the pen off (read mode); turn the pen on to write in a light color.

sections.label: Start here
steps: Download from Etsy in a web browser (the Etsy app cannot download files). Open the PDF in Goodnotes with Share, then Open in Goodnotes, or in Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes or Xodo.
Go to the Setup check page and tap the buttons. If they jump, you are ready. If not, the fix is on that page.
The pages are dark, so pick white, a pale gray or a light color in your app's pen settings. Save it as a favorite so it is always one tap away.
Tap this month below, then today's date. Buying October 26 to 31? Tap November 2026: its first week starts Monday, October 26. The head start leads straight into January 2027.
sections.tip: Pen off to follow a link, on to write. To type, use your app's text tool and set the text color to white.

build_notes: Night base theme with rainbow null.
